bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, people blocked roads at night due to continuous powercuts, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.
In Velachery near Nehru Nagar, a sudden road subsidence caused traffic disruption, and the office should coordinate immediate repairs.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for cyclone impact in Tiruvallur, and the district team must stay alert.
In Besant Nagar in Chennai, a drug awareness marathon was flagged off by Minister Puduy Anand, and the constituency team should note local youth engagement.
Near Tiruttani, parents and students fear poisonous creatures in the overgrown school campus, and the district team should urge immediate clearing.
In Manavalanagar, damaged pathway slabs on the ROB put residents at risk, and the office should coordinate with highways for repairs.
Near Tiruttani, a panchayat office operates in a dilapidated rural library building, and the office should watch for new building proposals.
Cisco executive Jeetu Patel supports unlimited artificial intelligence access for Gen Z to accelerate software development, and the portfolio team should monitor industry trends.
OpenAI chief Sam Altman questioned personal computer memory usage amid DRAM shortages, and the portfolio team should track hardware implications.
